info.description: This is a powerful email service API for batch sending and management.
info.title: Go Email Service API

get.description: Retrieves a list of all configured email service provider accounts.

post.description: Adds a new third-party email service provider account.

get.description: Retrieves the details of a specific account by its ID.

put.description: Updates the details of an existing account. The request body should contain the full account object.

400.description: Invalid account ID or request body

delete.description: Deletes an account by its ID.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all senders (AccountSender) associated with a given account ID.

200.description: A paginated list of account senders

post.description: Queues a single, non-template email for immediate sending. This is suitable for transactional emails.

202.description: message: Email queued for sending, record_id: 12345

post.description: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all recipient groups.

post.description: Creates either a static or a dynamic recipient group. For static groups, provide member_ids. For dynamic groups, provide rules.

get.description: Retrieves details of a specific recipient group by its ID.

put.description: Updates a recipient group's details. For dynamic groups, rules can be updated.

delete.description: Deletes a recipient group and its associations.

post.description: Adds a list of recipients to a static group.
post.summary: Add members to a static group

delete.description: Removes a list of recipients from a static group.
delete.summary: Remove members from a static group

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all recipients. Can be filtered by name (fuzzy), email (exact), and metadata fields. Supports both traditional pagination (page/pageSize) and search_after pagination for deep pages.

parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 10) - for traditional pagination
parameters.name: pageSize

parameters.description: Base64 encoded search_after value for deep pagination
parameters.name: search_after

parameters.description: Number of items per page (default: 50) - for search_after pagination
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description: Filter by recipient's first or last name (fuzzy search).
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Filter by recipient's email address (exact match).
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: Filter by metadata field, e.g., metadata.promo_code=WINTER25
parameters.name: metadata.

post.description: Adds a new recipient to the system.
Upload CSV, Excel, or JSON file to create multiple recipients.

get.description: Downloads a sample CSV file with headers and example data to demonstrate the required format for batch uploads.
Downloads a sample JSON file with the required structure and example data for batch uploads.
Retrieves a paginated list of the current user's import tasks.
Retrieves the status and progress of a batch import task.
Retrieves details for a specific recipient.

put.description: Updates the details of an existing recipient.

400.description: Invalid recipient ID or request body

delete.description: Deletes a recipient from the system.

post.description: Creates a new sender entity (e.g., a person or department).
Associates a sender with an account, creating a usable 'from' email address with a specific sending limit.

500.description: Failed to associate sender with account

get.description:
Get comprehensive email sending statistics with various filters and grouping options.
Provides overall summary, time series data, and sender performance analysis.

parameters.description: Group results by: day, week, month, sender
parameters.name: group_by

200.description: The data field contains the comprehensive statistics

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all email tasks.

post.description: Creates and queues a new task to send emails to a list of recipients. Either a template_id or a subject/body pair must be provided. This endpoint is asynchronous and will return a task ID upon successful queuing.

403.description: Forbidden - User does not have permission to use the specified sender

get.description: Get a summary of sending statistics for a specific task.

200.description: The data field will contain the task summary

get.description: Get a detailed list of all email send records for a specific task.

404.description: Task not found or no records for this task

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of email templates. If page and pageSize are not provided, returns all templates.
Retrieves a specific email template by its ID.

400.description: Invalid template ID or request body

delete.description: Deletes an email template by its ID.

post.description: Renders a preview of a template with sample data.

400.description: Invalid template ID or request body

post.description: Creates a new user account. This is a protected endpoint.

409.description: User with this username or email already exists

handler.CreateAccountRequest.description: Request body for creating a new Aliyun email account.

body.example: Dear valued customer, here is a special offer just for you!

handler.CreateTemplateRequest.description: Request body for creating a new email template.

has_next.description: Indicates if there are more pages

handler.UpdateTemplateRequest.description: Request body for updating an existing email template.

subject.example: A Warm Welcome to Our Service!

model.Account.description: Holds credentials and configuration for an external email service.

model.AccountSender.description: Represents the many-to-many relationship between accounts and senders, with specific sending configurations.

model.EmailSendRecord.description: Logs the details and delivery status of each individual email.

model.EmailTask.description: Defines a task to send a specific email (or template) to a list of recipients.

aliyun_tag_name.description: Fields for tracking via Aliyun API

model.EmailTemplate.description: Stores predefined subject and body for emails.

model.Recipient.description: Stores information about a person who can receive emails, including custom data.

model.RecipientGroup.description: Defines a group of recipients, which can be a fixed list (static) or rule-based (dynamic).

model.RecipientGroupRule.description: A rule used to dynamically include recipients in a group based on their attributes.

model.RecipientImportTask.description: Tracks the status and progress of batch recipient import operations.

model.Sender.description: Contains information about the sender of an email.

model.User.description: Defines a user of this email service platform, with roles and access rights.

service.TaskSummary.description: Provides a high-level overview of an email task's performance.

ApiKeyAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and a JWT token.
ApiKeyAuth.name: Authorization
